metadata.name: 坡顶民居 — Cedar and zinc gable house
limitations: Blender Python parameter generation is retained in source/build.py; JavaScript exposes saved states only.
Procedural material graphs become finite-resolution UV-baked PBR textures; they are not editable procedural JS shaders.
Cloth/armatures/modifiers are exported as evaluated saved-state geometry, without a web physics or rig solver.
Cycles and three.js use different lighting and BSDF implementations; exact pixel identity is not claimed.
Unsupported surface closures, material displacement/volume, and unsupported linked channels cause export failure.
Pivots preserve Blender local matrices; set matrixAutoUpdate=true after editing position/quaternion/scale in JavaScript.
